class_definitions.COLOR: Measured colour differs from the brand/reference hex beyond Delta E tolerance.
class_definitions.CONTACT: Objects intersecting or failing to attach at contact frames.
class_definitions.DEFAULTS: A generic fallback used where a measured reference value was required; caught by the banned-list lint before render.
class_definitions.EASING: Velocity-profile error vs reference: wrong spacing, wrong curve/spring, damped or smeared motion, motion jumps.
class_definitions.HIDDEN HISTORY: Frame N depends on frame N-1 state; seek(t) is not a pure function of time (carried state, jumps).
class_definitions.INVENTED FACTS: On-screen string/handle/logo/font content that does not exist in the asset manifest (study section 5).
class_definitions.RENDER ARTEFACTS: Encoder/render defects: smearing, ghosting, flashes, flicker, streaks, unmeasurable frames, collapsed similarity.
class_definitions.SIGNS: A sign, screen, label or face reading wrong: wrong place, wrong direction, ambiguous text.
class_definitions.STAGING: Subject/title/element placed wrong in frame, missing from frame, or merged into the background.
class_definitions.TASTE: Scored-rubric failure: first frame black, opening cut, hook/readability failure (human-gate territory).
class_definitions.THE FILE: The file itself is wrong: shape, frame count, fps, profile, missing report/weights/source, predicate tamper.
class_definitions.TIMING: Event peak frame vs reference outside 1 frame; hold shorter than the 1.2 s floor; event missing/late.

likely_causes: expected element absent from the frame at that second
layer detection missed the element
ABSENT.source: layout.py _absent() flag used by stage_rows() (S8 info-only layout rows; never a failure, never changes the verdict)
ABSENT.suggested_fix: Re-stage the missing element into the frame at that second, or correct the expected-layout table.

likely_causes: two labels too close / overlapping
text clusters merged by similar size/position
AMBIGUOUS_CLUSTERS.source: layout.py: returned when text clusters cannot be unambiguously assigned (e.g. Sudan vs El Fasher)
AMBIGUOUS_CLUSTERS.suggested_fix: Separate the labels (position/size) so each cluster maps to exactly one label.

likely_causes: palette token wrong or unmeasured (guessed hex)
colour-space / gamma mismatch in render
brand orange rendering peach
COLOR_FAIL.source: stages.py S1 fail() when Delta E2000 or CIE76 exceeds 3 in a flat region
COLOR_FAIL.suggested_fix: Correct the palette token to the measured reference hex (with source frame + sample coords); never correct the gate.

likely_causes: corrupt or missing video file
unsupported codec/container
ffmpeg decode error
DECODE_FAIL.source: decode.py decode_frames() raises RuntimeError 'DECODE_FAIL <path>' on ffmpeg failure
DECODE_FAIL.suggested_fix: Verify the file exists and ffprobe reads it; re-encode or re-download the source; do not proceed with a partial decode.

likely_causes: event scheduled on the wrong frame
event energy too weak (move too small / too slow)
event rect wrong
EVENT_MISSING.source: stages.py S2 fail() when the render event peak is <50% of the reference peak or >1 frame off
EVENT_MISSING.suggested_fix: Move the event to the reference peak frame (within 1 frame) and raise its energy to at least the reference ratio; check the beat grid.

likely_causes: render frame count != 10s x fps
render not 1920x1080
FAIL.source: stages.py S0 fail() with literal code 'FAIL' for frame-count or resolution mismatch
FAIL.suggested_fix: Fix the render dimensions/frame count at the source; this is a file-shape failure, not a look failure.

likely_causes: renderer fell back to a default font (asset font missing or unmeasured)
wrong font family/weight vs the reference
FONT_SWAP_SUSPECT.source: stages.py S3 result['flags'] when label 2x crop SSIM < 0.9
FONT_SWAP_SUSPECT.suggested_fix: Use the verified asset font (assets/fonts: Montserrat Bold / Anton) with the measured family/weight; add the fallback to banned.json if it recurs.

likely_causes: reference video is 23.976 fps while the scene is 24 fps (Seg3 known cause)
wrong reference file supplied
FPS_MISMATCH.source: stages.py: CheckError raised when reference fps differs from segment fps
FPS_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: Conform the reference to the segment fps before render, or set the segment fps to the measured reference fps; never resample silently.

likely_causes: layer scaled to fill the frame instead of its measured ratio
camera framing wrong at that second
FRAME_FILLING.source: layout.py stage_rows(): group flag when a layer fills the frame
FRAME_FILLING.suggested_fix: Restore the measured area/border ratio for the layer; check camera framing at that second.

likely_causes: mild smearing / geometry drift on that frame
colour or staging slightly off on that frame
FRAME_SSIM.source: stages.py S5 fail() when per-frame SSIM is under 0.90 but at/above the 0.85 floor
FRAME_SSIM.suggested_fix: Inspect the worst-frame diff still for that frame; fix the named cause (motion, staging, or colour) rather than the SSIM number.

likely_causes: render is smeared/damped relative to the reference (motion trails, frames 3-139 pattern in Seg3)
wrong staging/geometry for the whole shot
frame misalignment (decode offset)
HARD_FLOOR.source: stages.py S5 fail() when per-frame SSIM < 0.85 hard floor
HARD_FLOOR.suggested_fix: Fix the motion first (EASING): the per-frame collapse is the symptom, the damped motion is the cause. Verify frame alignment before re-rendering.

likely_causes: label placed in the wrong region entirely
label rect measured from the wrong frame
LABEL_WRONG_PLACE.source: stages.py S3 fail() when label ink IoU is under 0.5
LABEL_WRONG_PLACE.suggested_fix: Re-stage the label: re-measure its rect from the reference at the labelled frames.

likely_causes: torch/lpips not installed in the running venv
LPIPS weights unreachable under memory pressure
LPIPS_UNAVAILABLE.source: stages.py S6 result['flags'] when torch/lpips weights cannot load
LPIPS_UNAVAILABLE.suggested_fix: Run the LPIPS stage in the engine venv where torch+lpips import; if unavailable, verdict is INCOMPLETE, never a silent skip.

likely_causes: map labels/lines mis-staged (G8 line/text ratio failures)
map hold too short after a label (G9)
MAP_GATE_FAIL.source: stages.py S7 fail() when the G8 or G9 report has failures (segment 4 map gate only)
MAP_GATE_FAIL.suggested_fix: Fix the failing G8/G9 item in the map staging (line/text ratios, hold >= 1.2 s after label), then re-run the map stage.

likely_causes: map stage never ran
map report written to the wrong path
MAP_REPORT_MISSING.source: stages.py S7 fail() when no g8-g9 report exists at <out>/../g8-g9-report.json (segment 4 map gate only)
MAP_REPORT_MISSING.suggested_fix: Run the G8/G9 map stage and place its report at the expected path before the checker gate.

likely_causes: perceptual dissimilarity: texture/detail loss, smearing, wrong geometry
colour spread halved vs reference
MEAN_LPIPS.source: stages.py S6 fail() when mean LPIPS (alex) exceeds the pred-v1 segment bar
MEAN_LPIPS.suggested_fix: Restore reference detail/geometry at the worst frames; check colour spread, not just mean Delta E.

likely_causes: systematic pixel-level error: colour, geometry, or smearing across the shot
MEAN_PSNR.source: stages.py S5 fail() when mean PSNR is under the pred-v1 segment bar (dB)
MEAN_PSNR.suggested_fix: Same as MEAN_SSIM: fix the dominant per-frame cause, then re-measure; PSNR is a symptom aggregate.

likely_causes: systematic per-frame similarity collapse (see HARD_FLOOR / FRAME_SSIM rows)
damped motion across the shot
MEAN_SSIM.source: stages.py S5 fail() when mean SSIM is under the pred-v1 segment bar
MEAN_SSIM.suggested_fix: Do not chase the mean: fix the worst frames and the dominant per-frame code first, then re-measure.

likely_causes: layer rendered in the base colour / no separation from the background
z-order or opacity wrong
MERGED_WITH_BASE.source: layout.py stage_rows(): group flag when a layer merged with the base
MERGED_WITH_BASE.suggested_fix: Restore separation between the layer and the base (colour, opacity, or z-order) so the layer reads as its own element.

likely_causes: wrong ease/spring for the move (damped or smeared motion: render trails the reference)
flow interpolation interval too long without a keyframe re-anchor
camera/travel timing wrong
reference fps mismatch (23.976 vs 24) shifting frames
MOTION_ERR.source: stages.py S4 fail() for full-frame shift >=2 px and for per-target shift >=2 px (row.target names the target)
MOTION_ERR.suggested_fix: Re-pick the ease/spring from the reference velocity profile (Unit B picker); shorten the flow interval / re-anchor at keyframes; fix fps first.

likely_causes: per-target move uses the wrong ease/spring
target rect drifted from the reference centroid trajectory
MOTION_ERR_TARGET.source: Light-check-only aggregation label (handover-motion-style-copy/units/C/check/light-report.json failures list); NOT a checker-source code. Same measurement as MOTION_ERR with row.target set; kept so light reports classify without forcing.
MOTION_ERR_TARGET.suggested_fix: Same as MOTION_ERR, per target: re-pick the ease from the target's reference trajectory; re-measure the target rect.

likely_causes: velocity discontinuity: keyframe gap, ease change mid-move with no blend
carried state / seek(t) impurity snapping the pose
flow warp re-anchor snapping
MOTION_JUMP.source: stages.py S4 fail() when |err - prev_err| > 4 px between consecutive frames
MOTION_JUMP.suggested_fix: Blend the ease across the keyframe boundary or insert an intermediate key; run the seek(t) purity test (frame N must not depend on frame N-1).

likely_causes: checker run against a draft render
render-report.json profile field wrong
NOT_FINAL.source: stages.py S0 fail() when render profile is not 'final'
NOT_FINAL.suggested_fix: Re-render with profile 'final' and re-run the checker; do not grade a draft.

likely_causes: expected on-screen text is absent (placeholder or blank where real text belongs)
text rendered too faint/small to cluster
NO_TEXT_CLUSTERS.source: layout.py: returned when no text clusters are found where text was expected
NO_TEXT_CLUSTERS.suggested_fix: Put the real manifest text on screen at a readable size; never ship placeholder bars as text.

likely_causes: predicate.json edited (threshold lowered or changed)
predicate.sha256 out of sync
PREDICATE_TAMPERED.source: stages.py load_predicate() raises PredicateTampered when predicate.json sha256 mismatches predicate.sha256; cli.py exit 7
PREDICATE_TAMPERED.suggested_fix: Restore predicate.json from the frozen pred-v1 copy; never edit the predicate to make a check pass.

likely_causes: reference supplied at a non-1080p size and resized by the checker
REF_RESIZED.source: stages.py S0 result['notes'] when the reference is not 1920x1080 (not a failure or flag; recorded for traceability)
REF_RESIZED.suggested_fix: Supply the reference at 1920x1080; treat any comparison against a resized reference as provisional.

likely_causes: candidate geometry fails the layout discriminator (wrong shape/position)
discriminator thresholds stale for this segment
REJECTED_BY_DISCRIMINATOR.source: layout.py _absent('REJECTED_BY_DISCRIMINATOR'): candidate layer rejected by the layout discriminator
REJECTED_BY_DISCRIMINATOR.suggested_fix: Re-measure the layer geometry from the reference; if the discriminator itself is wrong, fix it as a versioned tool change, never in place.

likely_causes: progressive resolve is a blur-back: mid-resolve frames are smooth (no dab/detail structure) while the end frame is sharp, i.e. a blurred copy of the final still played back in increasing sharpness
detail_structure measured absent at mid frames (mid-third median Laplacian variance under threshold) while the end frame matches the resolved end state
end-frame similarity was used as the only resolve check, so a high end SSIM rescued a fake
RESOLVE_BY_BLUR.source: stages.py S9 check_progressive_resolve() / stage_s9(), Unit B stage2-coarse-fine-2026-11-08-01; thresholds from Unit A working pair (true mid-median lap_var 747.32, fake mid-median 9.42; threshold 100.0)
RESOLVE_BY_BLUR.suggested_fix: Rebuild the resolve as real coarse-to-fine dabs: mid-resolve frames must carry detail structure (mid-third median lap_var at or above 100.0, hf_ratio at or above 0.02 at 480x270); do not ship a blur-back whose only proof is a sharp end frame.

likely_causes: measurement precondition failure: the chosen reference region is not actually flat, so no colour verdict is possible
ROI rect wrong
ROI_NOT_FLAT.source: stages.py S1 fail() when the reference ROI p95 Delta E exceeds 2 (region is not flat)
ROI_NOT_FLAT.suggested_fix: Pick a genuinely flat reference region (re-measure); do not loosen the Delta E gate to pass a bad ROI.

likely_causes: label positioned from an unmeasured guess
font metrics differ from reference (wrong family/weight)
label animated with the wrong ease
TEXT_SHIFT.source: stages.py S3 fail() when a label ink-box edge shifts >2 px
TEXT_SHIFT.suggested_fix: Re-measure the label rect from the reference frame; verify font family/weight against the asset manifest.

likely_causes: frame is flat/featureless so phase correlation has nothing to lock onto
black or blank frame
UNMEASURABLE.source: stages.py S4/S5 result['flags'] when phase_shift returns None for a frame (flat/featureless frame)
UNMEASURABLE.suggested_fix: Check the flagged frames are not black/blank (TASTE: first frame black); if genuinely flat, record as unmeasurable, not as passing.

coverage.note: 30 codes come from checker source (20 failures + 3 flags + 1 note + 6 layout flags). The 31st mapped code, MOTION_ERR_TARGET, is a light-check-only aggregation label from light-report.json, mapped so light reports classify cleanly; it is marked kind 'failure' with source 'light-check-only' above.

named_but_absent_from_source.CAMERA_LATE: Named in the task brief and study section 6 as an example checker code; grep over src/checker/*.py finds no such string. No mapping invented. If a future checker stage adds it, it belongs to TIMING (camera lands 0.2 s before its event).
named_but_absent_from_source.G8_FLOOD: Named in the task brief and study section 6 as an example checker code; grep over src/checker/*.py finds no such string. No mapping invented. If a future checker stage adds it, it belongs to STAGING (G8 map flood/line-ratio failure).
named_but_absent_from_source.HOLD_SHORT: Named in the task brief and study section 6 as an example checker code; grep over src/checker/*.py finds no such string. No mapping invented. If a future checker stage adds it, it belongs to TIMING (hold shorter than the 1.2 s floor after a label).

source: Enumerated from ~/workspace/headless-motion-engine/src/checker/*.py (stages.py, decode.py, layout.py, cli.py) by grep over fail()/flags.append()/CheckError/PredicateTampered/DECODE_FAIL and layout.py flag strings, 2026-11-08. No code was guessed: every entry below names its source location.
